name: motif_count
author: ae9bcafc
description: Counts common three-node structural motifs without sampling. Use it to compare how often triangles, open triads, feed-forward loops, or directed three-cycles occur. It supports directed and undirected graphs, ignores weights and self-loops, and returns exact integer counts; directed results also include reciprocal edge pairs.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph whose small motifs should be counted.
